"""Transcribe a media file with faster-whisper (local, CPU).

Usage: python asr.py <media> [--lang zh] [--model large-v3] [--out segments.json]
Prints one line per segment: [start -> end] text
"""
import argparse
import json
import subprocess
import tempfile
import wave

import numpy as np
from faster_whisper import WhisperModel


def load_audio(path: str, rate: int = 16000) -> "np.ndarray":
    """Decode any media file to mono float32 PCM with ffmpeg."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        wav = f"{tmp}/audio.wav"
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-loglevel", "error", "-y", "-i", path,
                        "-vn", "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "wav", wav],
                       check=True)
        with wave.open(wav, "rb") as fh:
            frames = fh.readframes(fh.getnframes())
    return np.frombuffer(frames, dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("media")
    ap.add_argument("--lang", default=None, help="e.g. zh, en; omit to auto-detect")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default="large-v3")
    ap.add_argument("--compute-type", default="int8")
    ap.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=8)
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="also write segments as JSON here")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    model = WhisperModel(args.model, device="cpu", compute_type=args.compute_type,
                         cpu_threads=args.threads)
    segments, info = model.transcribe(load_audio(args.media), language=args.lang,
                                      vad_filter=True, word_timestamps=True)
    print(f"# language={info.language} prob={info.language_probability:.2f} "
          f"duration={info.duration:.1f}s")
    rows = []
    for seg in segments:
        print(f"[{seg.start:7.2f} -> {seg.end:7.2f}] {seg.text.strip()}", flush=True)
        rows.append({
            "start": round(seg.start, 2), "end": round(seg.end, 2),
            "text": seg.text.strip(),
            "words": [{"w": w.word, "s": round(w.start, 2), "e": round(w.end, 2)}
                      for w in (seg.words or [])],
        })
    if args.out:
        with open(args.out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            json.dump(rows, fh, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<script>
    // Solidify nav on scroll
    const topbar = document.getElementById('topbar');
    const setTopbar = () => {
      const y = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
      topbar.classList.toggle('solid', y > 40);
    };
    setTopbar();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', setTopbar, {passive:true});

    // Dropdown behavior
    const dropdowns = [
      document.getElementById('dd-portfolio'),
      document.getElementById('dd-insights')
    ];

    function closeAll(except){
      dropdowns.forEach(dd => {
        if(!dd) return;
        if(dd !== except){
          dd.dataset.open = "false";
          const btn = dd.querySelector('button');
          if(btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        }
      });
    }

    dropdowns.forEach(dd => {
      if(!dd) return;
      dd.dataset.open = "false";
      const btn = dd.querySelector('button');
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const isOpen = dd.dataset.open === "true";
        closeAll(dd);
        dd.dataset.open = isOpen ? "false" : "true";
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', dd.dataset.open === "true" ? "true" : "false");
      });
      dd.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
        if(e.key === 'Escape'){
          dd.dataset.open = "false";
          btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          btn.focus();
        }
      });
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', () => closeAll(null));
    document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => { if(e.key === 'Escape') closeAll(null); });

    // Reveal on scroll (staggered)
    const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if(entry.isIntersecting){
          entry.target.classList.add('in');
          io.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.12 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach((el, idx) => {
      const d = el.style.getPropertyValue('--d');
      if(!d) el.style.setProperty('--d', (idx % 6) * 60 + 'ms');
      el.style.transitionDelay = el.style.getPropertyValue('--d');
      io.observe(el);
    });

    // Lightweight parallax on visual cards (subtle)
    const parallaxEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax]'));
    const floatEls = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-float]'));
    function parallax(){
      const y = window.scrollY || 0;
      const vh = window.innerHeight || 800;

      parallaxEls.forEach(el => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const t = (r.top + r.height/2 - vh/2) / (vh/2);
        const amt = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, t)) * 10;
        el.style.transform = `translateY(${amt}px)`;
      });

      floatEls.forEach(el => {
        const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        const t = (r.top + r.height/2 - vh/2) / (vh/2);
        const amt = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, t)) * 8;
        el.style.transform = `translateY(${amt}px)`;
      });
    }
    parallax();
    window.addEventListener('scroll', parallax, {passive:true});

    // Drag-to-scroll for carousels (mouse + touch)
    function enableDragScroll(track){
      let isDown = false;
      let startX = 0;
      let scrollLeft = 0;

      const onDown = (pageX) => {
        isDown = true;
        startX = pageX;
        scrollLeft = track.scrollLeft;
        track.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto';
      };
      const onMove = (pageX) => {
        if(!isDown) return;
        const dx = (pageX - startX);
        track.scrollLeft = scrollLeft - dx * 1.15;
      };
      const onUp = () => {
        if(!isDown) return;
        isDown = false;
        track.style.scrollBehavior = '';
      };

      track.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        if(e.button !== 0) return;
        onDown(e.pageX);
      });
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => onMove(e.pageX));
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);

      track.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => onDown(e.touches[0].pageX), {passive:true});
      track.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => onMove(e.touches[0].pageX), {passive:true});
      track.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      track.addEventListener('touchcancel', onUp);
